prompt: What can the packing crew do during the check?
promptZh: 檢查期間，包裝人員可以做什麼？

options.text: Pack orders and set the boxes aside without recording their weights.
options.zh: 繼續裝箱，放一旁，先不記重量。
options.whyZh: 男子同意包裝，但要等看過空帶兩筆讀值才登記出貨重量。

options.text: Keep weighing boxes but stop packing new orders.
options.zh: 繼續秤箱子，但先停止新訂單裝箱。
options.whyZh: 安排恰好相反：可裝箱，暫不登記重量。

options.text: Record the weights of the boxes as long as the belt is stopped.
options.zh: 只要皮帶停止，就可以登記箱重。
options.whyZh: 還沒看兩筆空帶讀值前，不可登記出貨重量；沒有停帶例外。

options.text: Put every completed box on the conveyor for the test.
options.zh: 把每個裝好的箱子都放上輸送帶測試。
options.whyZh: 空帶檢查不放箱子；裝好的箱子先放一旁。

explanationZh: 男子同意包裝，但要等看過空帶兩筆讀值才登記出貨重量。
evidence: Can the packing crew keep boxing orders while we check? / Yes. Set the boxes aside as they’re packed. Don’t record any shipment weights until we’ve looked at those two empty-belt readings.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
